description: Forecast impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, cost, conversions, and CPA for a temporary keyword campaign. Supports targeting, negatives, match type, three bidding strategies, explicit future dates, and an optional independent per-keyword breakdown. This read-only planless RPC does not create a campaign or saved plan.

biddingStrategy.description: Supported bidding strategy for this temporary forecast. The request does not create a live campaign.

conversionRate.description: Expected conversion rate as a decimal, e.g. 0.02 for 2%

currencyCode.description: Optional ISO 4217 conversion currency; account currency is used by default

customerId.description: Google Ads serving customer ID; use a relevant client account for better estimates

dailyBudget.description: Daily amount in standard currency units; required for maximize strategies and optional for MANUAL_CPC

endDate.description: Optional inclusive forecast end YYYY-MM-DD, no more than one year ahead; supply with startDate

geoTargetIds.description: Google Ads geo-target constant IDs for the intended locations.

includeKeywordBreakdown.description: Make independent one-keyword forecast calls in addition to the combined campaign forecast

keywordBreakdownLimit.description: Safety cap for additional rate-limited Keyword Planner requests

keywords.description: Keyword phrases to analyze; use the language and market of the intended audience.

languageIds.description: Google Ads language constant IDs for the intended audience.

matchType.description: Google Ads keyword match type for the forecast.

maxCpcBid.description: Bid in standard account-currency units; required for MANUAL_CPC

maxCpcBidCeiling.description: Optional standard-currency CPC ceiling for MAXIMIZE_CLICKS

negativeKeywords.description: Keyword phrases excluded from the keyword forecast.

negativeMatchType.description: Match type applied to the negative keywords.

network.description: Google Ads search network selector used for planning.

startDate.description: Optional inclusive future forecast start YYYY-MM-DD; supply with endDate

name: google_ads_generate_keyword_forecast_metrics

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: google ads generate keyword forecast metrics
